During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''Wroonian male''' amassed a large fortune. As a result, the [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian's]] grandson, [[Fume Pachoola]], was able to live off his grandfather's wealth without ever having to work.
